scripts.android:prepare: bun run build:web && bun scripts/write-native-runtime.ts && bash ./scripts/with-java17.sh cap sync android && bash ./scripts/patch-android-java.sh
scripts.android:apk:debug: bun run android:prepare && cd android && bash ../scripts/with-java17.sh ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:release: bun run android:release:check && bun run android:prepare && cd android && bash ../scripts/with-java17.sh ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:aab:release: bun run android:release:check && bun run android:prepare && cd android && bash ../scripts/with-java17.sh ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.ios:sync: bun run build:web && bun scripts/write-native-runtime.ts && cap sync ios
scripts.prettier: prettier --write capacitor.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json prettier.config.js tsconfig.json scripts/*.ts
